d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Panama vs Egypt in Group A of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Egypt eased to a 4-1 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Yousef Abdullah struck twice, Khaled Mokhtar added a third and Mohamed Gamal converted a penalty, with Thiago Chalmers scoring for Panama. Egypt finish second in Group A behind Greece to reach the Round of 32, while Panama exit the tournament.
